rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say an object is someone’s property.

example.english: This book does belong to me.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use this when specifying the physical place where an item should be kept.

example.english: This is where the book should belong.
example.jyutping: bun2 syu1 jing1 goi1 fong3 hai2 syu1 gaa2

rows.note: Use this for being part of a group or accepted sphere rather than for ordinary ownership.

example.english: We belong to the international education sector.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 suk6 jyu1 gwok3 zai3 gaau3 juk6 gaai3

rows.jyutping: hai6 A ge3 ling6 jat1 bun3
rows.note: Use this specifically to say that someone is another person’s romantic partner or spouse.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ling6 jat1 bun3
